test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Article 51A of the Indian constitution provides for ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fundamental Duties.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Article 51A contains fundamental duties:-

 
 
• to abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem
 
• to cherish and follow the noble ideals which inspired our national struggle for freedom
 
• to uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India
